app.title: SwissCareerScore
app.tagline: Compare Swiss occupations and education paths on official data — with your own weights.

disclaimer.long: Scores combine official Swiss statistics with documented estimates. They describe averages of broad occupation groups, not your personal prospects. Use them to ask better questions — talk to a career counsellor (berufsberatung.ch) before deciding.

pay.name: Pay
pay.desc: Gross monthly wage: 30 % entry, 50 % mid-career, 20 % earning potential (top-decile wage).

stability.name: Job stability
stability.desc: Low registered unemployment in the occupation.

demand.name: Demand
demand.desc: Share of employers that find it hard to recruit at this level in this sector.

aiResilience.name: AI resilience
aiResilience.desc: Low exposure of the occupation's tasks to AI and automation (estimate).

trainingEase.name: Training ease
trainingEase.desc: High share of learners who complete the training.

entryAccess.name: Easy entry
entryAccess.desc: Low admission hurdles (numerus clausus, aptitude tests, limited places).

timeToQualify.name: Fast start
timeToQualify.desc: Few years from the end of compulsory school to qualification.

careerGrowth.name: Career growth
careerGrowth.desc: Wage progression from under 30 to over 50 in the occupation group.

workLifeBalance.name: Work-life balance
workLifeBalance.desc: Little night work and moderate usual weekly hours.

flexibility.name: Remote / flexibility
flexibility.desc: Share of people in the sector who work from home at least occasionally.

mobility.name: International mobility
mobility.desc: Recognition abroad, language independence and transferability (rubric).

regional.name: Regional availability
regional.desc: Available in many regions and language areas (rubric).

meaning.name: Meaning / societal value
meaning.desc: No defensible Swiss per-occupation source yet — off by default.

weights.title: What matters to you?
weights.presetHelp: Balanced = equal weights (see methodology). Moving any slider switches to Custom.
weights.overlap: {a} and {b} move together (ρ = {rho}). Weighting both counts a similar signal twice.

modeHelp.absolute: Each dimension is scored on a fixed, documented scale, so magnitude counts: pay uses a log curve where CHF 300k a year = 100.
modeHelp.relative: Each dimension is ranked against all other occupations (or paths): best = 100, worst = 0. Differences in magnitude are lost.

weights.flawHelp: With a penalty, one very weak dimension pulls the overall score down more than an equally strong one lifts it.

filters.title: Filters
filters.hint: Filters only hide entries; scores and ranks stay comparable.

list.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
list.insufficientTip: Less than 60 % of your weights are backed by data. Shown without rank.
list.fragileTip: Rank moves by up to {shift} places if any single weight changes by ±20 %.
list.pool: Occupations and education paths are ranked separately (percentiles within each group).

entity.breakdownHelp: Each bar shows weight × dimension score. Missing dimensions are dropped and their weight is redistributed.
entity.radarDesc: Dimension scores from 0 (worst in group) to 100 (best in group).
entity.dataHelp: Click any value to see its source, year and confidence.
entity.sensitivityHelp: Largest rank change when one weight is changed by ±20 %.
entity.scaleAbsolute: Dimension scores use absolute value scales (see methodology).
entity.scaleRelative: Dimension scores are percentile ranks within the group.
entity.leadsDesc: Occupations this training qualifies you for, ranked by your current weights.
entity.nextDesc: Education paths you can take next.
entity.pathsDesc: Education paths that lead into this occupation.
entity.noLinks: No career links recorded for this entry.

inputs.telework: Works from home at least occasionally
inputs.payEntryExpert: Pay ~1 year after degree — expert estimate

source.title: Source
source.missing: No data — this value is missing and is not imputed.

compare.title: Compare
compare.empty: Select up to 4 entries in the ranking to compare them side by side.

ahp.title: What matters more?
ahp.desc: Answer a few pairwise questions. We derive weights with the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP).
ahp.question: Which matters more to you?
ahp.inconsistent: Your answers contradict each other somewhat (CR > 0.10). Consider revisiting them.

groups.effort: Low effort to qualify (training ease, easy entry, fast start)

share.help: Your settings are stored in the URL — share or bookmark it.

home.eyebrow: Swiss careers, scored with official data
home.title: Find the job or training that fits what matters to you
home.subtitle: Rank 450+ Swiss occupations and 800+ apprenticeships, colleges and degrees by pay, security, AI risk, work-life balance and more — with sources for every number.
home.sources: Data: BFS, SECO, berufsberatung.ch + flagged expert estimates

afterSchool.title: After compulsory school
afterSchool.desc: Apprenticeships, Gymnasium, FMS or direct entry

afterApprenticeship.title: After an apprenticeship
afterApprenticeship.desc: BM, HF, professional exams, FH bachelor

afterMatura.title: After the Matura
afterMatura.desc: All 128 university, ETH, FH and PH programmes with pay and unemployment

matura.title: Every study path in Switzerland, compared
matura.intro: All bachelor and master programmes at Swiss universities, ETH/EPFL, universities of applied sciences (FH) and universities of teacher education (PH): where you can study them, admission, pay 1 and 5 years after the degree, unemployment and drop-out. Each number blends the official BFS graduate statistic with our own programme-level estimate, and both are shown.

uh.title: University / ETH
uh.desc: Open admission with a gymnasial Matura. Bachelor 3 years + master 1.5–2 years; the master is the usual exit degree. ETH/EPFL weed out in the first-year exam.

fh.title: University of applied sciences (FH)
fh.desc: Practice-oriented bachelor in 3 years. With a gymnasial Matura you first need about one year of work experience in the field (art schools: portfolio/aptitude test).

ph.title: Teacher education (PH)
ph.desc: Direct admission. Kindergarten/primary 3 years, lower secondary 4.5 years. Strong teacher shortage in most cantons.

med.title: Medicine (numerus clausus)
med.desc: Human, dental, veterinary medicine and chiropractic: EMS aptitude test in German-speaking Switzerland, selection after year 1 in Geneva and Lausanne.

matura.gapYear: Not sure yet? A gap year, the military/civilian service or working first are common.
matura.gapYearLink: See the score for starting work with a Matura only →
matura.listHelp: Scored with your current weights (set them on the ranking page). Click a name for the full breakdown and sources.
matura.results: {count, plural, =0 {No programmes} one {# programme} other {# programmes}}
matura.legend: Large number = value used for scoring (official statistic blended with our estimate). Small print: BFS statistic · own estimate. Pay is gross per month (annual ÷ 12), full-time.
matura.yearsTo: {years} years after the Matura to the usual degree
matura.institutionsHelp: Public universities, ETH domain, universities of applied sciences and arts, and universities of teacher education. Click a number to filter the list.
matura.catalogueSource: Institution lists compiled from university websites and
matura.institutionNote: Institution differences are our estimates: a reputation premium where employers clearly favour an institution in this field, plus the regional pay level where its graduates usually work (half weight for university graduates, who are more mobile). They don't change the score, which is per field. ★ = especially strong in this field.
